text:
Beneath my dress a field burned with joyful flowers

like the children of midnight.

The breath of light in my bones when I write the word

earth. Word or presence followed by perfumed animals;

sad as itself, beautiful as suicide; and it flies

over me like a dynasty of suns.

translation.title: Beneath My Dress a Field Burned with Joyful Flowers...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the prose line's molten movement around the word earth.
